tei:div.tei:p: "!#༁ྃ: bde gshegs yongs 'dus las: snying po don gyi gnas gsal zhes mi 'gyur rdo rje'i lam gyi chings bzhugs so: :

bde gshegs yongs 'dus las: snying po don gyi gnas gsal zhes mi 'gyur rdo rje'i lam gyi chings ni: he ru ka la phyag 'tshal lo: ྈྈྈྈ zab mo ye shes mchog gi lam: bde gshegs yongs 'dus bka' yi lung: 'gyur med rdo rje'i gsang lam 'dir: zhugs shig 'bras bu'i sa la reg: rig pa'i rtsal dang bzlas pa rlung: myong ba rtsom pa'i rtog pa ni: ma rtsol yengs med rol pa che: lam 'dir 'gro ba'i grogs su bstan: thog mar bla ma lhag pa'i lha mchog la: 'jug pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs yongs 'dus bla ma la: skyabs mchi gsang chen dngos grub stsol: sems bskyed pa ni: gsang chen ye shes zab bcud kyis: 'gro rnams gtan bde'i go 'phang bsgrub: 'gro rnams rlung sems snang stong la: bde gshegs snying po dbyer med bsre: mtshams bcad pa ni: hūm̐: rang snang skad cig dran rdzogs he ru ka: mnyam nyid ye shes rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs: gzung 'dzin gnyis 'dzin gdon bgegs rang ngor dengs: skal med bar chad ma 'da' rang sar dengs: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: mnyam nyid khro rgyal mi g.yo rang grol rtsal: hūm̐ dang khro chung mtshon cha me ri'i gur: gsang sngags lha yi rang rtsal ye shes lha: lhun grub 'dus ma byas pa'i rten du gyur: a a a: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.āḥbadz+ra rak+ṣa hūm̐: brda sgo dbye zhing brda phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐ hūm̐: rang grol mi g.yo mnyam nyid ye shes kyi: rang mdangs bde gshegs zhi khro'i rol par shar: rang snang lha la rang rig phyag bya ba'i: cir snang chos nyid rol pa'i klong du blta: byin dbab pa ni: hūm̐: chos dbyings dag pa rang grol lhun grub la: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgya mtsho sprin bzhin 'dus: mnyam pa nyid la thugs rje mnyam rol pa'i: bde gshegs zhi khros rnal 'byor byin gyis rlobs: badz+ra sa ma ya ā be sha ya pheṃ pheṃ dzaḥdza: mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni:

hūm̐: gtsang sbyar phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa'i tshogs: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ gis me rlung 'byung bas sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin brlabs spel cing bsgyur: rnam lnga'i 'dod yon mchod tshogs sprin ltar 'khrigs: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ḥ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra nai wid+ya āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rū pa āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra rā s+ya āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra spar+she āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha āḥhūm̐: oṃ: bdud rtsi'i sman la rigs lnga'i bcud stsol cig: ā: 'khor ba'i khrag la gīrtī'i dmar chen stsol: hūm̐: sha lnga gtor ma bdud rtsi'i ngo bor gyur: ā: byang chub mchod pa kun bzang yangs pa che: oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba pañtsa a mṛta ma hā rak+ta ma hā ba liṃ ta bo dhi tsit+ta hūm̐ hrīḥṭhā: ting 'dzin rnam gsum ni: oṃ: ka nas dag pa'i dgongs pa chos kyi sku: oṃ ma hā shūn+ya tā: ā: lhun gyis grub pa'i rang mdangs longs spyod rdzogs: hūm̐: gang 'dul sprul sku rgyu yi sems dpar snang: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta dz+nyā na satwa kro ta hūm̐: hūm̐: sems dpa' mthing ga rdo rje dril bu 'dzin: rgyan med gang 'dul thugs rje'i mkhyen brtser chags: oṃ badz+ra he ru ka satwa sa ma ya: ma nu pā la ya: badz+ra he ru ka twe no pa tiṣ+ṭha: dṛ ḍho me bha wa: su to ṣ+yo me bha wa: a nu rak+to me bha wa: su po ṣ+yo me bha wa: sarba sid+dhi m+me pra yats+tsha: sarba karma su tsa me tsit+taṃ shre yaḥku ru hūm̐: ha ha ha ha ho: bha ga wān: sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra mā me muñtsa: badz+rī bha wa ma hā sa ma ya: badz+ra he ru ko bha wa satwa ā: ye shes 'du 'phro'i gdan steng 'khor lo'i dbus: thugs rje'i rig mdangs hūm̐ las hūm̐ mdzad la:

khro bcu mi g.yo 'khor lo rtag tu 'khor: byang chub bar gyi srung zlog dam tshig zungs: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐: snod sbyang ba ni: e yaṃ ra suṃ keṃ raṃ bh+rūm̐ 'phros pas: nam mkha'i dbus su rlung steng rak+ta'i mtsho: zhing chen sa gzhi kiṃ rus ri rab me: dag pa yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag: bh+rūm̐ bi shwa bi shud+dhai bhan+dha dz+nyā na tsakra maṇ+ḍa la e bh+rūm̐: skam rlon rtsig pa thod tshal drwa ba dang: zhing gi re lde zhing lpags sgo khebs sogs: dur khrod gzhal yas pho brang gling dgur ldan: ma 'dres lhun grub mtshan nyid yon tan rdzogs: gdan bskyed pa ni: bsam zhing sprul pa'i byol song lha chen gdan: steng du dbyangs gsal nyi zla'i mtshan dpe'i mdangs: rdo rje bhan+dha a haṃ gnyis med kyi: gnyis med lhun mnyam ye shes lnga rdzogs kyi: rang bzhin pad nyi'i steng du dpal chen po: che mchog he ru mthing nag nam mkha'i mdangs: sa lam gzi mdangs rngam pa'i nyer gcig dbu: phyag rgya zhe gnyis bde gshegs dkyil 'khor rdzogs: gnyis med dgyes mdzad gnam zhal bde bar rol: yon tan dpal dang dur khrod chas kyis brgyan: thabs shes gsang ba gnyis med dkyil 'khor du: zla ba oṃ dang nyi ma muṃ 'phro 'du: sa ma ya ho: sa ma ya s+t+waṃ: rā ga ya ho: rā ga ya mi: a la la ho: dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho: hūm̐ hūm̐: hūm̐: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i byang sems thig le'i cha: sa bon snying po brgyad gyur 'phros pa las: shar du khrag 'thung yab yum rigs mdangs 'khor: lho phyogs gshin rje yab yum rigs mdangs 'khor: nub tu dbang chen yab yum rigs mdangs 'khor: byang du phur pa yab yum rigs mdangs 'khor: shar lho bla med yab yum rigs mdangs 'khor: lho nub rig 'dzin yab yum rigs mdangs 'khor: nub byang dregs pa yab yum rigs mdangs 'khor: byang shar drag sngags yab yum rigs mdangs 'khor: phyi rim dpal gyi bka' sdod 'khor bcas gsal:

oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ hūm̐ trāṃ hrīḥ.ā: sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer gsal ba la: ye shes rnam pa lnga yis byin gyis brlabs: hūm̐: bde gshegs thams cad 'dus pa'i dam tshig las: snang stong gnyis med chu zla 'ja' tshon ltar: gang shar yi dam rol pa yengs med kyi: mthar thug kun mkhyen lha dang dbyer med gyur: oṃ badz+ra kro ta ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: spyan drang ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i zhing mchog gsang chen lhun grub nas: rgyal ba'i mthu stobs kun 'dus dpal chen po: gang 'dul phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs zhi khro'i tshogs: mdzad pa lhun grub 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs la: phrin las 'gro ba'i don du gshegs su gsol: hūm̐: bde gshegs kun gyi dpal chen che ba'i mchog: gshin rje dbang chen khrag 'thung sku gsung thugs: bdud rtsi yon tan phrin las phur pa dang: rig rtsal dregs pa drag sngags bka' sdod 'khor: mdzad pa lhun grub dbyer med 'dir gshegs shig: badz+ra sa ma ya dza dza: bzhugs su gsol ba ni: hūm̐: rgyal ba'i thugs rje gnas yul kun khyab la: 'gro 'ong gshegs bzhugs gnyis med klong yangs kyang: rjes 'jug 'dod pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa la: brtse bas rjes 'jug skyong phyir thugs rjes bzhugs: badz+ra sa ma ya pa sha tiṣ+ṭha lhan: phyag 'tshal ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs yongs la sgo gsum phyag 'tshal lo: thog med da dus ma rig nyes sgrib bshags: byin rlabs gsang chen dkyil 'khor 'jug pa'i bcud: dpal chen he ru ka dang dbyer med mdzod: a ti pū ho: pra tīts+tsha ho: a la la ho: mchod 'bul ni: hūm̐: bdag gis bsod nams ye shes tshogs rdzogs phyir: dngos 'byor yid sprul ting 'dzin rol pas mchod: phyogs bcu'i bde gshegs rgya mtsho dgyes pa'i mdangs: byin rlabs thugs rjes bdag rgyud byin gyis rlobs: oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe=

oṃ badz+ra dhū pe= oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke= oṃ badz+ra gan+dhe= oṃ badz+ra nai wid+ya= oṃ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ āḥbadz+ra rū pa pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa khaṃ swā hā: oṃ āḥbadz+ra shab+da= oṃ āḥbadz+ra gan+dhe= oṃ āḥbadz+ra rā s+ya= oṃ āḥbadz+ra spar+she= nang mchod kyi dang po sman 'bul ba ni: ye shes pa mngon du gsal btab la: hūm̐: bde gshegs yongs 'dus khro bo'i lha tshogs la: 'gro kun nyon sgrib sbyong phyir sman 'bul bas: nyon mongs thugs rje'i sman gyis 'tsho mdzad cing: ye shes rnam lngas sgrib pa rang grol mdzod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā sarba pañtsa a mṛta la khā hi: dngos grub kyi bcud blang ba ni: hūm̐: rgyu rkyen sgrub pa'i gsang chen dam pa'i rdzas: bde gshegs rten dang byin gyis brlabs pa'i bcud: nyon mongs 'khor ba sgrol phyir bcud blangs par: bde gshegs rgya mtsho'i rang bzhin byin gyis brlabs: kā ya wā ka tsit+ta sarba sid+dhi hūm̐: rak+ta 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs yongs 'dus zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: 'gro kun bdag 'dzin bsgral phyir rak+ta 'bul: 'gro rnams ma rig bsgral nas rig pa'i bcud: bdag 'dzin rang grol mnyam nyid mi g.yo shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā rak+ta la khā hi: gtor ma 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs yongs 'dus zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: 'gro 'dul bsod nams thob phyir gtor ma 'bul: rang don chos sku gzhan don gzugs sku'i gter: 'gro kun zhi bar bskyal ba'i stobs rdzogs shog: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ma hā ba liṃ ta la khā hi: don snying lnga sogs 'bul ba ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs yongs 'dus zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: 'gro kun rtog tshogs sbyang phyir don snying 'bul: nga rgyal phrag dog chos nyid dag pa'i klong: mi g.yo mnyam nyid ye shes rang grol shog: ma hā māṃ sa ma hā rak+ta ma hā tsit+ta ma hā go ro tsa na ma hā ba su ta la khā hi: byang chub sems kyi mchod pa ni:

hūm̐: bde gshegs yongs 'dus zhi khro'i lha tshogs la: 'gro kun gnas lugs rtogs phyir byang sems 'bul: mnyam nyid kun bzang dgongs pa mngon gyur nas: kun mkhyen ye shes go 'phang myur thob shog: oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha pū tsa ho: bstod pa ni: hūm̐: bde gshegs gsang chen rigs rnams kun 'dus pa'i: che ba'i che mchog dpal chen rngam pa'i sku: zhi ba rdo rje dbyings kyi phyag rgya ldan: rigs bzhi khrag 'thung dbus na 'gying la bstod: hūm̐: mthu stobs 'bar ba gar dgu'i nyams ldan gyis: bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis zhi ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dzin: lha brgyad klu brgyad gdan la g.yas g.yon rol: zhi khro rigs 'dus lha la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'dzab dbyangs ni: hūm̐: sgo gsum lha sngags ting 'dzin mi g.yo bar: bde gshegs yongs 'dus zhi khro zab mo'i lam: bskyed rdzogs nus pa gsang sngags bcud 'byin pa'i: dam tshig bde ba chen po'i klong du 'jug: oṃ āḥhūm̐ swā hā: oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐: oṃ a kro te ka ya mān+ta ka ha na ma tha bhañdza hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ pad+mān+ta kṛta ma hā kro dha ha ya grī wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya sarba bigh+nān baṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ gu h+ya dz+nyā na shrī he ru ka hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra gu ru sarba hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭān e dza bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa: khroṃ ga ru ḍa hūm̐ phaṭa: sarba ḍā ki nī sid+dhi sa ma ya hrīṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: grangs dang tshad dang rtags dang sbyar: dus su rnal 'byor rol pa'i dga' ston bya ba ni: rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni: raṃ yaṃ khaṃ: ye shes rol pa'i dag byed 'byung bas sbyangs: oṃ āḥhūm̐: chos dbyings mdangs kyis byin rlabs spel zhing bsgyur: gsang chen sngags kyi longs spyod rdzas su gyur: zhi khro yab yum sras 'khor ma lus kun:

gang la dgyes pa de bzhin lhun gyis grub: tshogs kyi spyan 'dren ni: hūm̐: 'dus ma ye byas 'og min chos kyi dbyings: dag pa lhun grub zhing gi ston pa'i tshogs: dgongs pa lhun grub mkha' klong dbyer med kyi: mkhyen brtse mdzad phrin dga' ston tshogs la gzigs: tshogs phud 'bul ba ni: 'khor ba'i rang rgyud bsgral ba'i 'dod yon tshogs: du ma ro gcig zag med ye shes bcud: bde gshegs yongs 'dus zhi khro'i lha la 'bul: bzhes nas gsang chen ye shes bdag la stsol: ga ṇa tsakra la khā hi: gnyis pa bshags pa ni: tshig gis gsal gdab pa ni: hūm̐: gsang chen ye shes bcud chen 'di bzhes la: gsang 'os gsang ba 'chal ba mthol zhing bshags: dus gsum sgrib pa'i nyams pa sor chud nas: dri med chos sku'i dgongs pa mngon gyur mdzod: bsgral las dgug gzhug dang: hūm̐: bde gshegs lha tshogs thugs rje drag por bzhengs: mi srun rngams pas mtshon cha'i char phob cig: dgra bgegs log lta'i bsam sbyor rten dang phrol: ru dra bgegs kyi chos min gzhom du gsol: bstab pa ni: hūm̐: rngams brjid rol pa zhi khro'i zhal gdangs pa'i: klong du log spyod dgra bgegs kha kha khā hi: mthar thug bar du bar chad med par mdzod: mi mthun dug lnga dbyings su dag par gyis: rdo rje slob dpon la drangs te: ho: las bzhi'i ston pa rdo rje rgyal po dgongs: phrin las bzhi yi zag med tshogs la rol: zhes drangs te slob dpon gyis: ho: shes nyon zhi zhing yon tan zhing khams rgyas: 'khor 'das dbang dang drag po'i phrin las spyod: rgyal tshab la: ho: slob dpon gnyer 'dzin rgyal tshab gnyis pa dgongs: phrin las bzhi yi zag med tshogs la rol: zhes drangs te: yang: hrī: gsang chen bcud kyi dam rdzas yon tan gyi: gang la gang 'dul de bzhin longs spyod do: 'dus pa rgya mtsho la slob dpon gyis: ho: gsang sngags rdzas kyi yon tan 'dod rgu'i gter:

spyod cig byang chub sems kyis 'gro don gyis: phud lhag rim gsum ni: hūm̐: dang po phud kyis zhi khro'i lha tshogs mchod: bar du tshogs kyis ma mo mkha' 'gro bskang: tha ma lhag mas bka' sdod chos skyong gsol: gtso dang sras 'khor khyad par mchod pa che: rgyu 'bras thig le nyag gcig chos nyid bsre: oṃ a mṛta sa ma ya ā be sha ya ā: lhag ma ni: bh+yo: dpal gyi bka' nyan rol pa'i lhag sdud pa'i: dbang mo nyer brgyad ging chen bco brgyad dang: mkha' 'gro so gnyis ma bdun sring mo bzhi: 'bar ma zhing skyong pho nya drug cu bzhi: dur khrod bdag mo mkha' 'gro shugs 'gro'i tshogs: zhing chen gon zhing gnas yul dur khrod nyul: bhan+dha bdud rtsi dmar chain sha khrag rol: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: sngon tshe dpal chen slob dpon bka' bzhin du: da lta rnal 'byor brgyud 'dzin sdongs grogs mdzod: oṃ badz+ra rat+na pad+ma karma bi shwa lo ka sarba sa ma ya ḍā ki nī: yak+sha rak+sha bhū ta pre ta sarba ma hā pū dza khā hi khā hi: zhes 'bul: de nas sngon gyi chad don gyi tha tshig ni: bh+yo: sngon tshe bar dang bskal pa'i tha ma la: kun bzang he ru ka dang pad+ma yi: rim bzhin spyan sngar khas blangs dam bcas pa'i: phyi nang dregs pa bka' srung thams cad kyis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las sgrubs shig phyi nang dregs pa'i tshogs: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' chos skyong rnams: bh+yo: rtsod dus lnga brgya tha ma'i snyigs dus 'dir: bcom ldan dpal chen pad+ma thod phreng gis: gdul dka' 'dul byed klong gsal snying po la: dbang bskur lung bstan mthu rtsal byin pa'i tshe: khas blangs dam bcas dregs pa bka' srung gis: dgra bgegs sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las sgrubs shig phyi nang dregs pa'i tshogs: bka' dang dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya:

brtan skyong ni: bh+yo: sngon tshe slob dpon pad+ma'i spyan snga ru: khas blangs dam bcas sgrub mchog grogs kyi gnyen: bdud mo bzhi dang gnod sbyin sman mo bzhi: bod khams skyong ba'i skyong ma 'khor dang bcas: sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la: phrin las sgrubs shig ma mo brtan ma'i tshogs: bka' dang dam tshig ji bzhin dgra bgegs sgrol: bsam don lhun grub bya ba mthar phyin mdzod: la lā: le lai: ta tā: te tai: ma mā: zor 'phen ni: ho: phyogs bcu'i lha klus zor thun lam phye 'tshal: lha srin sde brgyad grogs mdzod zor dang chas: drag po'i zor gyi thun lam 'di bcu tshang: dpal chen bka' bzhin dus las ma 'da' zhig: hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes 'phangs la mnan pa ni: ming dang cha mthun bag nyal rjes snyogs shing: mgo bskor bag nyal dgra bgegs mnan par s+t+waṃ: sems bskyed bar du ldang ba'i gnas min no: sa ma ya hūm̐ laṃ hūm̐ laṃ s+t+waṃ bha ya nan: tshe 'gugs ni: hrīḥhūm̐: phrin las rnam bzhi sgrub pa'i rang mdangs snying: mi shigs skye 'chi gnyis med tshe yi lha: lha dang drang srong grub pa tshe yi bcud: lha klu mnga' thang 'byung ba'i bcud kyis rgyas: hrīḥhrīḥhrī: bkra shis ni: hūm̐: zhi khro khrag 'thung rigs 'dus mthu rtsal gyis: nus pa mi zad gter gyi bkra shis char: sgrub mchog bkra shis dpal la spyod bzhin du: khams gsum sems can kun la bde legs stsol: bsngo ba dang smon lam ni: bskyed rdzogs 'bras bu'i dge bas 'gro ba kun: sngon las 'phral rkyen sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing: dga' bde ye shes dpal la rol pa'i tshe: zhing rnams kun tu chos 'khor bskor gyur cig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: phyi rabs skal ldan gangs khrod du: bskyed rdzogs snying por lam bya zhing: 'bras bu ye shes bcud blangs pa'i: go 'phang tshul 'dir bsgrub par rigs: zhing la nas btab nas smin bzhin: lha 'di'i sa bon de bzhin no:

dkyil 'khor gcig la rgyud dgu yi: nus pa 'byin pa'i gnad dam zhig: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: dpal mgon dregs pa'i tshogs kyis bka' 'di srungs: sa ma ya: rgya rgya rgya: gter rgya: sbas rgya: zab rgya: gsang rgya: zhes rol pa bde chen khang nas spyan drangs pa'i rin po che'i shog ser las/ khol ri gsang sngags sgrub khang rtser klong gsal snying pos zhal bshus pa'i yi ge pa ni skal ldan pad+ma kun bzang stobs chen gyis brtson pa'o/// /
